Exchange rate

Set exchange rates between foreign currencies and the base currency.

Exchange rates determine conversion values for multi-currency transactions.

Date

Enter the date for this exchange rate. The system uses the rate effective on or before the transaction date when calculating foreign currency conversions.

Exchange rates should be updated regularly to ensure accurate financial reporting, especially if your business has significant foreign currency transactions.

Consider entering rates at month-end for financial reporting, or more frequently for volatile currencies.

Currency

Select the foreign currency this exchange rate applies to. Each foreign currency requires its own exchange rate entries.

The rate defines how many units of the selected currency equal one unit of your base currency (or vice versa if using inverse rates).

Exchange rate

Enter the exchange rate between your base currency and the selected foreign currency.

You can enter the rate in either direction - use the inverse button to switch between formats.

For example, if 1 USD = 0.85 EUR, you can enter either 0.85 or use inverse to enter 1.18 (1 EUR = 1.18 USD).

The system automatically converts between formats, so use whichever is more convenient or matches your source data.
